description: A segmented bar with a rubbery glass thumb: it stretches as it jumps, sets an anchor and glides into the new cell with momentum.
interactionNotes: Clicking any cell makes the glass thumb spring to that cell, stretching mid-flight and squashing its trailing edge. Dragging the thumb across the bar lets you move between cells; releasing with speed gives momentum and settles it on the nearest cell. Arrow keys also work — in RTL `ArrowLeft` moves forward.

props.items: The options; a string or a `{ value, label, icon }` object.
props.value: Controlled mode; pass it to own the value control.
props.defaultValue: Initial value in uncontrolled mode; if omitted, the first option.
props.activeTextColor: Text color of the one the thumb sits on.
props.inset: Inner margin of the thumb from the bar's edge, in pixels.
props.stretch: Stretch percentage during the jump; zero means no stretch.
props.squash: Squash amount of the trailing edge, in pixels.
props.speed: Animation speed multiplier; 1 is the default.
props.draggable: Whether dragging the thumb across the bar is enabled.
props.aria-label: Accessible name of the radio group.

tips: For Persian, a three-to-four option bar is the sweet spot; keep `equalSlots` on so the cells are the same size and the thumb does not wobble in the middle.
This component needs no manual mirroring: the reading direction of the layout comes from the page's own flex, and the arrow keys swap based on `direction` — in RTL `ArrowLeft` moves forward.

If the indicators are too low-contrast (a light background with a light bar), make `trackColor` one step darker than the surface, not one step lighter; this is the only place where the bar's contrast shows.
With `prefers-reduced-motion` the spring jump becomes a simple change; momentum and stretch also turn off but selection still works correctly.
